sensei_drum.brief: Create drum patterns using modern sample chopping techniques and sparse rhythmic fills to reflect aggressive mood and West Coast style.

bass_generator.brief: Generate bass lines that lock tightly with drums to maintain groove and emphasize strong hooks.

harmony_generator.brief: Design harmonic layers with sampled chords utilizing chopping techniques to fill space without overcrowding.

melody_generator.brief: Compose hook melodies based on chopped samples with high energy while keeping verses sparse.

ai_designer.brief: Coordinate arrangement flow ensuring sparse verses and energetic hooks, applying appropriate sample chopping naming for channels.

presetor.brief: Apply presets to maintain aggressive tonal quality and modern production style consistent with West Coast Hip-Hop.

songgps.brief: Manage section transitions and energy curve to maintain overall aggressive and dynamic feel throughout the 80 bars.

ai_mixmaster.brief: Prepare channel audio unmixed for downstream processing, preserving clarity between chopped sample layers.
